label: TP
reason: User-controlled input from HTTP headers flows directly into SQL query string via string concatenation without parameterization. The 'bar' variable (derived from user-supplied header value) is concatenated into the SQL statement at line 84 without any escaping or prepared statement protection, enabling SQL injection attacks.

evidence.note: User input extracted from headers and URL decoded
Parameter passed to doSomething without sanitization
SQL query constructed via string concatenation with unsanitized user input
